name: fluent-frame
description: Local-first Chrome extension for bilingual YouTube subtitles and English learning notes.

scripts.e2e:ci: pnpm build && xvfb-run -a playwright test e2e/extension.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:live: pnpm build && FF_LIVE_YOUTUBE=1 playwright test e2e/live-youtube.spec.ts
scripts.eval:ai: pnpm --filter @fluent-frame/shared build && pnpm --filter @fluent-frame/native-host build && node scripts/ai-eval.mjs
